cm_perf_council_probe = {
	if = { limit = { is_system_automated = cabinet } debug_log = "CM council probe $WHEN$: cabinet on" }
	else = { debug_log = "CM council probe $WHEN$: cabinet off" }
	if = { limit = { is_system_automated = cabinetactions } debug_log = "CM council probe $WHEN$: cabinetactions on" }
	else = { debug_log = "CM council probe $WHEN$: cabinetactions off" }
	if = { limit = { is_system_automated = cabinetmembers } debug_log = "CM council probe $WHEN$: cabinetmembers on" }
	else = { debug_log = "CM council probe $WHEN$: cabinetmembers off" }
	every_cabinet = {
		if = { limit = { has_cabinet_action = yes } debug_log = "CM council probe $WHEN$: seat busy" }
		else = { debug_log = "CM council probe $WHEN$: seat idle" }
	}
}
